What stopped you from saying something to her?

results.user: So what is wrong with me? Why do I keep doing this everywhere?
results.visibleReply:
Nothing is wrong with you. This is a pattern you learned — somewhere, at some point, it became the way to stay safe or stay loved or stay acceptable. It makes complete sense that it's everywhere, because you didn't learn it in one place. You learned it as a way of being.

The more interesting question isn't "what's wrong with me" — it's "where did I learn that my needs don't get to exist?"

Do you have any sense of when this started? Not the full story — just whether it feels old, like something from long before your partner and your boss and your friend.
